title: Step 6: Calling check_winner() and check_draw() Functions

blocks.content: Step 6: Calling check_winner() and check_draw() Functions

items: Add code to call check_winner() and check_draw() functions from the play() function of the Game class.

blocks.content: Each time a user enters a position, we have called the check_winner() function to see if a player won or not. If a player won the game, we have used the break statement to end the while loop.
Similarly, we have called the check_draw() function each time after the board is updated and if the winning condition is not met.
Now, our game is complete. Run this code and see for yourself how this code works.
